message.content:
You are a senior frontend engineer + product designer. Build the routines UI for a hackathon product (demo Sunday 14:00, hand-in 12:00; it must be polished, reliable and understandable for procurement buyers, not developers). Work directly in the repo; do NOT commit or push (the lead commits after review). Other engineers work in parallel on OTHER files: you may ONLY edit web/src/components/Routines.tsx and create new files under web/src/components/routines/ (e.g. RoutineFlow.tsx, RoutineEditor.tsx). Do not touch App.tsx, DecisionCard.tsx, Rail.tsx, StatusStrip.tsx, lib/api.ts, or any Python. If you need something from those, write it down in your final report instead.

Repo: /Users/jonasstenglein/OtherProjects/StartMunichHack/ask-soony. Stack: React 19, Tailwind v4 (tokens in web/src/index.css: text-ink / ink-2 / ink-3, border-line, bg-panel, ok = blue #1d6fe0, stop = red), lucide-react icons, radix Sheet in web/src/components/ui/sheet.tsx, Button in ui/button.tsx, helpers post/fmtTime/fmtDay in web/src/lib/api.ts. No new npm packages (native HTML5 drag and drop only). Read the current web/src/components/Routines.tsx first (it is mounted in the header by App.tsx with props {state, onChanged, request} — keep that exact export and props contract: `export function Routines({ state, onChanged, request }: { state: State; onChanged: () => void; request?: { cardId: string; k: number } | null })`, where `request` opens the sheet and starts drafting for that card).

Backend API (already implemented in src/ask_soony/routines.py, read it for details):
- GET /api/routines → {routines: Routine[]}; Routine = {id, name, description, spec?, code, enabled, created_from?, created_at?, runs?: Run[] (newest first), handled?: number}
- POST /api/routines/suggest {card_id} → {routine: Routine (draft, not saved, has spec + note), preview: Run}  (takes 5-30 s, an LLM writes it)
- POST /api/routines/edit {routine: {id,name,description,spec,created_from?}, instruction: string} → {after: Routine, note: string, preview: Run}  (LLM, nothing saved; note non-empty = the request could not be applied, show it)
- POST /api/routines/preview {id,name,description,spec,created_from?} → {routine (with compiled code), preview: Run}  (deterministic, fast; use after drag/drop/remove edits) — returns HTTP 400 with a reason if the recipe is invalid
- POST /api/routines {id,name,description,spec,created_from?} → saves (new ones start enabled; an existing id keeps its switch, runs and memory)
- POST /api/routines/{id}/toggle {enabled}; POST /api/routines/{id}/run → Run; DELETE /api/routines/{id}
- Spec: {when: [{id, field: evidence|headline|option_action|option_to|supplier_name|kind, op: contains|is|any_of, value, text}], then: [{id, do: carry_out|notify|log, match?: {to?, action_contains?}, channel?: phone|teams|both, message?, text}]}. `text` is the buyer-readable phrase for every block. The system always adds a guard: options that cost money or change the plan are never carried out; the buyer is told instead.
- Run = {at, ok, dry?, result?, error?, log?: string[], did?: [{do: 'carry_out'|'notify', card?, option?, text?, channel?, status?, dry?}]}

Design (from our UI expert; follow it, use judgement):
1. RoutineFlow: one routine as blocks a buyer understands at a glance. Card frame rounded-xl border border-line bg-white p-4. Header: name (text-[16px] font-bold) + a real switch (h-5 w-9 rounded-full, bg-ok on / bg-line off), not a pill. Stats line text-sm text-ink-3: "Handled N cards · Last ran HH:MM · <what it did or 'Nothing to do'>". Blocks stacked with a thin connector (ml-6 h-3 w-px bg-line): WHEN (label text-xs font-bold uppercase text-ink-3; conditions as chips rounded-md bg-panel px-2 py-1 text-sm ring-1 ring-line showing `text`, never field names), THEN (label text-ok; one row per step with icon: Send for carry_out, Smartphone/MessageSquare/BellRing for notify by channel, NotebookPen for log), and a fixed ALWAYS block (border-dashed bg-panel, Lock icon): "Costs money or changes the plan? It comes to you." — not removable, not draggable. Footer: Run now, Delete (ghost), "Show the code" collapsed (for Q&A). Routines without spec (legacy, code only) render name/description + code only.
2. Editing: (a) a "Change it in your words" input under the blocks (placeholder e.g. “also tell me on Teams”) → POST /edit → show a review state: before/after diff by block id (added: bg-ok/5 ring-1 ring-ok/40 + "New" tag; removed: opacity-60 line-through + "Removed" tag text-stop; changed: old phrase struck then new), the note if any, then "Test on today's inbox" with the preview steps, buttons "Apply change" (disabled if the test failed) / "Keep as is". (b) Direct manipulation without libraries: × on hover removes a condition chip or a step; HTML5 drag to reorder THEN steps; a small palette under THEN with chips you can click or drag in: "Tell me on my phone" (notify phone, message "{headline}"), "Tell me on Teams" (notify teams), "Note it in the history" (log). Each direct edit → POST /preview → same review state (Apply / Keep). Generate new ids for added blocks.
3. Draft view (after suggest): same RoutineFlow inside border-2 border-ok/50 bg-ok/5, title "Suggested routine", the test run between blocks and buttons; buttons "Turn on" / "Not now"; editing also works on the draft before saving. While suggest runs, show a clear "The agent is writing a routine from your decision…" state.
4. Sheet: widen to sm:max-w-[560px] (pass className to SheetContent if supported; check ui/sheet.tsx). Title "Routines", subtitle "Written by an agent from your decisions. They run in a closed sandbox on every check. Anything that costs money or changes the plan still comes to you." Below the routines: "Automate a decision you made" list (decided cards: status approved/sent/escalated/dismissed; show the status with a proper word like "Approved"/"Sent", headline line-clamp-2; cards that already have a routine show "Automated · <routine name>"; the card behind an open draft is hidden).
5. Copy: plain buyer language, no internal codes (no amber, level, routine_type, channel, spec, option). Consistent section headings: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-ink-3.
6. The trigger button in the header: keep it compact (icon + label "Routines" visible from lg, count badge when some are on), use lucide `Workflow` icon instead of Cog.

Verify: `cd web && npx tsc --noEmit -p . && npm run build` must pass. The app is served live from this checkout at http://127.0.0.1:8000 (login form at /login; password: read ASK_DASHBOARD_PASSWORD from .env, never print it). Take screenshots with headless Chrome to check your work visually, e.g. `PW=... uv run --quiet --with playwright python script.py` using `p.chromium.launch(channel="chrome")`, logging in via the form; put scripts and screenshots in /Users/jonasstenglein/.claude/jobs/3021cc1a/tmp/ui-routines/. Do NOT call /suggest or /edit more than ~3 times total (each costs an LLM call); you may save/toggle/delete test routines, but leave data/state/routines.json as you found it at the end (back it up first) and never approve inbox cards (that sends real emails). Final report: what you built, screenshots paths, anything the lead must wire elsewhere.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Jonas: alert agent in one server
# Voice, push, card tools, supplier replies and call webhooks are routers from the alert agent. They
# read verifier-shaped cards through `api.get_state()` and the helpers below, which live in
# globe_api (his original dashboard API); importing it also starts his opt-in background loops
# (ASK_BACKGROUND=on, ASK_REPLY_POLL=on). The inbox's own state stays at /api/state.

from ask_soony import anchors, calls, cardtools, globe_api, push, replies, routines, teams, voice  # noqa: E402
from ask_soony.basic_auth import BasicAuth  # noqa: E402
from ask_soony.globe_api import (  # noqa: E402,F401  used by the routers as api.<name>
    ROOT,
    _action_status,
    _add_event,
    _now,
    _read,
    _state_dir,
    _write,
)

get_state = globe_api.get_state
for _router in (voice.router, push.router, cardtools.router, replies.router, calls.router, anchors.router, teams.router, routines.router):
    app.include_router(_router)
_GLOBE_ROUTES = {"/api/feed", "/api/network", "/api/mode", "/api/cards/{card_id}/action"}
app.router.routes.extend(r for r in globe_api.app.router.routes if getattr(r, "path", None) in _GLOBE_ROUTES)
app.add_middleware(BasicAuth)

content.text:
The routines UI is built: the flow graph, the editable step list with before/after review, the suggested draft, and the voice drafts are all in. `tsc --noEmit` and `npm run build` both pass, and nothing is committed.

I only touched `web/src/components/Routines.tsx` and the new `web/src/components/routines/` folder. The other modified files in `git status` belong to the other engineers.

**Server on port 8000 needs a restart before the demo.** It was started at 03:32, before the commit that added `/api/routines/preview` and `/edit`, and it has no auto-reload. Right now `/preview` answers 405 and `/suggest` returns old-style code without the recipe, so the new UI shows the legacy view there. It also won't have `/api/routines/drafts` from `cardtools.py`. Until it restarts, the voice-draft section just stays empty.

**What's built:**
- **Header button:** `Workflow` icon, with the "Routines" label shown from `lg` up. A blue count badge shows when voice drafts are waiting; otherwise a quieter badge shows how many routines are on.
- **Flow view (default on each card):**
  - Reads left to right in the wide view: "Every portal check", then the conditions stacked in one column, then one node per step.
  - The dashed "You decide" guard branches off the step that sends.
  - Counters come from the latest run ("2 matched", "1 sent", "1 told", "1 to you"), with a green ring on nodes that did something and a "Test run" tag for previews.
  - In the sheet it's vertical; "Expand" opens a near full-width sheet with the horizontal graph and the run result. On phones the guard drops below the send step.
- **Steps view (where editing happens):**
  - When / Then / Always blocks showing only the buyer phrases.
  - × on hover removes a condition or step; steps reorder by native drag and drop.
  - The palette adds "Tell me on my phone", "Tell me on Teams" and "Note it in the history" by click or drag. Each chip is hidden once that step exists.
- **Review before saving:**
  - Every direct edit goes through `/preview`; "Change it in your words" goes through `/edit`.
  - The review shows the diff by block id: New, Removed (struck through), Changed (old phrase struck, then the new one), Moved. It also shows a name change, the agent's note if any, and the test on today's inbox.
  - "Apply change" is disabled if the test failed; "Keep as is" drops the change. Edits can stack before applying. On a draft, Apply only updates the draft locally.
- **Suggested routine:** a "The agent is writing a routine from your decision…" state, then the same card in a blue frame with the test run, "Turn on" and "Not now".
- **Drafted from your call:** voice drafts appear at the top with "You said: …". Each one is re-tested once through `/preview` when the sheet opens. "Not now" hides it on that device only (stored in the browser, since there is no delete endpoint).
- **Rest of the sheet:** a real switch, the stats line ("Handled N cards · Last ran HH:MM · Sent 1 message, told you about 2 cards"), Run now, Delete with an inline confirm, and "Show the code".
  - Old routines saved as code only show their name, description and the code.
  - "Automate a decision you made" shows Approved / Sent / Passed on / Dismissed, and "Automated · <name>" for cards that already have a routine. The card behind an open draft is hidden.
- **Bug found and fixed:** dragging a step was dropping it at the end of the list instead of where it was released.

**How I tested it:**
- I ran a second copy of the server from this checkout on port 8011 with background loops off, since 8000 is out of date. Only `/preview`, which is a dry run, and one real `/suggest` reached the server.
- I made 1 real `/suggest` call (it took 2.5 s); `/edit` was mocked. Save, toggle, run and delete were all mocked in Playwright, so no cards were approved and no emails were sent.
- `data/state/routines.json` was backed up and still has the same two routines with the same switches. The test server is stopped.

**For you to wire elsewhere:**
- `sheet.tsx` already caps the sheet at 560px; I pass `sm:max-w-[560px]` anyway. The Expand view overrides it with `max-w-[min(1280px,100vw)]`.
- **Run now is real, not a dry run** (unchanged backend behaviour). It can send emails if the routine matches an open card, so avoid clicking it during a rehearsal unless you mean it.
- The lead may want a backend `DELETE /api/routines/drafts/{card_id}` so "Not now" on a voice draft is shared across devices.
